scenario.topic: Decide which multiplayer game to enter at the student esports event

options.name: Valorant Tactical Shooter
options.upside: Emphasizes teamwork and strategy with a strong competitive scene.
options.concern: Requires coordination for a 5-player team, which may be challenging with only 4 participants.

options.name: Rocket League Vehicular Soccer
options.upside: Fast-paced and accessible with a balanced mix of skill and fun.
options.concern: Gameplay may be less familiar to players new to vehicle-based controls.

options.name: Overwatch 2 Team Shooter
options.upside: Offers diverse hero roles and dynamic team play.
options.concern: Requires a 6-player team, which exceeds the participant number, needing substitutes or adjustments.

options.name: Among Us Social Deduction
options.upside: Encourages communication and social interaction in a simple format.
options.concern: Less focused on traditional esports skills and more on social strategy.

shared_context: Four students must select one multiplayer game to compete in at the upcoming student esports event. Each game supports four-player teams and has different gameplay styles, system requirements, and popularity among students.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a pragmatic gamer who values straightforward gameplay and accessibility.
personas.private_goal: To pick a game that the team can quickly learn and enjoy without complex controls.

A.reason_for: Valorant is popular and emphasizes teamwork and strategy.
A.reason_against: Requires a 5-player team, which is more than our 4 participants.

B.reason_for: Fits perfectly with 4 players, has low system requirements, and is fast-paced and fun.

C.reason_for: Offers dynamic team play and diverse roles.
C.reason_against: Needs 6 players, exceeding our team size, making it impractical.

D.reason_for: Low system requirements and easy to pick up with social interaction.
D.reason_against: Less focused on traditional esports skills, which might limit competitive edge.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a social and enthusiastic player who enjoys games that encourage communication.
personas.private_goal: To choose a game that maximizes team interaction and fun for everyone.

A.reason_for: Valorant has a strong competitive scene and requires teamwork.
A.reason_against: Needs 5 players, which is more than our team size.

B.reason_for: Accessible and balanced mix of skill and fun with 4-player teams.
B.reason_against: Some might find vehicle controls unfamiliar.

C.reason_against: Requires 6 players, exceeding our team size.

D.reason_for: Encourages communication and social interaction in a simple format.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a strategic thinker who enjoys complex team-based FPS games.
personas.private_goal: To compete in a challenging game that offers diverse roles and high skill ceiling.

A.reason_for: Strong competitive scene and strategic gameplay.
A.reason_against: Needs 5 players, which is more than our team size.

B.reason_against: Less complex than preferred FPS games.

C.reason_for: Offers diverse hero roles and dynamic team play.

D.reason_against: Not focused on traditional esports skills.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is an analytical player who values teamwork and competitive depth.
personas.private_goal: To select a game that balances strategic depth with team coordination.

A.reason_for: Emphasizes teamwork and strategy with a strong competitive scene.

B.reason_for: Low system requirements and accessible gameplay for 4 players.
B.reason_against: Vehicle controls may be unfamiliar to some.

C.reason_for: Diverse hero roles and dynamic play.
C.reason_against: Needs 6 players, exceeding our team size.

D.reason_against: Less focused on traditional esports skills.
